title: Arizer Air and ArGo Battery
description:
Maximize your vaporizing experience with the Arizer Air II and ArGo Battery, the perfect accessory for your Arizer portable vaporizers. This high-quality, long-life Li-ion 18650 battery is designed to keep your Arizer Air, Arizer Air II, and Arizer ArGo devices powered longer, enhancing both convenience and performance. A crucial replacement battery that ensures you never miss a session, it’s also an essential charge tester for maintaining optimal battery health.

Keep your vaporizer running safely and efficiently; avoid device damage and prevent injury with this reliable power cell. Ideal for those always on the move, it’s the smart choice for uninterrupted vaping pleasure.

COMPATIBLE WITH:
ARIZER AIR V1, ARIZER AIR SE, ARIZER AIR II, ARGO

NOT COMPATIBLE WITH AIR MAX
